data.message:
Compare moments, not clock times, for today's "from now" filter

The default "from now" filter for today took the time of day of now and kept
departures whose labelled local clock time was at or after it. A departure
labelled in another time zone, or one on the night the clocks go back, was
hidden or kept by the wrong hour. The filter now compares each departure's
moment with now. An explicit --after keeps its labelled local-time meaning.

Tests: the two new from_now tests fail on the old search.py and pass now.
The full offline suite (uv run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rfE) gives 696
passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed: test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0 fails
because it hard-codes --date 2026-11-20, which is in the past on the
2026-11-21 run date. That failure was already there before this change and is
not touched here.
